entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-10-20
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • ASP.NETCore contains System.Security.Cryptography.Pkcs but does not expose for reference #64125
  • AuthorizeRouteView: Add capability to include additional redirects #64124
  • JsonPatch.SystemTextJson: When serializing a `JsonPatchDocument`, "value":null is incorrectly emitted for "remove", "move" and "copy" operations. #64123
  • [Blazor] LayoutAttribute.LayoutType should have proper trimming annotation #64119
  • SseFormatter.WriteAsync does not flush after writing an event #64118
  • Force Auth Token refresh in Blazor WASM #64116
  • HTTP 405 Method Not Allowed to default Blazor Server template – breaks Bing/Google crawl #64115
  • [Wix 5] The .NET SDK/Runtime/Hosting bundle installer displays name and icons are incorrect in the taskbar #64114

Closed

  • Perf regression: json, multiple_queries #64108
  • Endpoint Routing does not respect AppendTrailingSlash property #64104
  • Non-framework JavaScript files fail to load due to unintended fingerprint markers #64060
  • Reuse of schema in derived classes (anyof) creates empty schema in open api spec with polymorphic json type info resolver #64024
  • XML Documentation for `PersistentStateAttribute.RestoreBehavior` is malformed. #64107

PullRequests

Created

  • Update CookieAuthenticationOptions XML documentation to clarify ExpireTimeSpan usage #64122
    Attention: Shared Code Modified
  • Fix CG alerts #64120
    area-infrastructure

Merged

  • Set timeoutInMinutes to 0 for Windows build job #64126
    9.0.11
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #64101
    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:, 10.0.0
  • Fix malformed XML documentation in PersistentStateAttribute #64113
    Attention: Shared Code Modified, 11.0-preview1

Updated

  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #64100
    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:, build-ops
  • Clarify Webhook vs Path Separation using Shared PathItemTypeAttribute #64088
    area-grpc, community-contribution
  • OpenAPI: Fix $ref handling for array circular references #64109
    area-mvc, community-contribution
  • Add support for cancelling regular hub invocations from client #64098
  • Blazor 404 code re-execution is compatible with `OnNavigateAsync` #64034
    area-blazor, 10.0.x
  • Doc updates #64092
    needs-area-label
  • Fix the bug with scrolling in Virtualize component with scaled elements #64013
    area-blazor
  • OpenAPI: Fix ModelMetadata null reference exception in emitted XMLComment transformers #63872
    area-mvc, community-contribution, feature-openapi
